name: awhittlewandering
description: A Whittle Wandering — a journey platform for long-haul trips with narrative moments and live presence

scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd backend/edge-worker && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=awhittlewandering
scripts.deploy:frontend:quick: cd frontend && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=awhittlewandering
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
